assessment: This test-only delegating handler selects a seeded session token to match actor IDs from the outgoing query/body and uses any seeded token for requests with no actor field. It reads the same top-level fields the application endpoints call acting-user IDs, while unauthenticated access tests explicitly use a raw client. That supports the integration suite identity checks; it is not production authorization code and establishes no financial integrity defect.
execution: Static-only test-helper review; no tests, API or DB activity.
